newsitem.title: USA: Fleetwood Q1 sales slipped three percent.
newsitem.headline: Fleetwood Q1 sales slipped three percent.

text.p: Fleetwood Enterprises Inc said Wednesday sales for its first quarter ended June 27 were about $729 million, off about three percent from last year.
It said a "significant" part of the shortfall was slower manufactured housing sales of $367 million, down from the record sales of $377.1 million from last year's first quarter.

Lower factory shipments in the company central and eastern regions also led to the sales decline. Fleetwood said it had a much stronger backlog a year ago of unfilled orders to draw from, and was able to operate at higher volume levels throughout last year's first quarter. But it said the rate of incoming orders in the current period has been running ahead of last year's pace by about seven percent.

The company also said recreational vehicle revenues were about $351 million for the quarter compared to $357.9 million. Its supply operations contributed revenues of about $11 million in the quarter compared to $16.2 million.
The company said it will report final sales and earnings for the quarter in about four weeks.
